# Code of Conduct

We follow the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, welcoming and constructive. Harassment, discrimination and personal attacks are not tolerated, in English or Portuguese.

Report problems to the maintainers by opening a private security/conduct advisory on the GitHub repository. Maintainers will review reports promptly and confidentially.
